# Vendored dependency

[SheetJS](https://sheetjs.com/) `xlsx` v0.18.5, Apache-2.0. Used only to read
.xlsx/.xls files the visitor drops into the Mini-Lab; nothing is written or
uploaded. Loaded on demand, so visitors who only use CSV never download it.

File is the unmodified ESM build (`xlsx.mjs`) from the npm tarball.
